items.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022
items.q: And 25 years later a friend of mine went and Vijay Iyer was the director of the thing.

ctx.x: So a lot of it is approach. I wanted to say one thing about the innovation thing. So we were talking about Banff. Wow I got off on a tangent. So I went to Banff I don’t know, right out of college, 1986, 1987. And 25 years later a friend of mine went and Vijay Iyer was the director of the thing. And what sounded like a very Kumbaya moment, I mean you know Banff is in the Canadian Rockies. It’s gorgeous up there. So he had everybody sit outside and introduce themselves, all the students on the first day, introduce…
